firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently spotted a dragon takes the Chapter deck and reads its first card aloud.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: This chooses the opening reader. During the Players' Phase, the group chooses its turn order and may change it between phases.
For a first game, use the Chapter I deck and keep the cards in order.
